Written Offer of Source Code (GNU GPL v2, Section 3(b))
========================================================

Lares distributes a copy of Git for Windows in the form of the "MinGit"
minimal runtime (hereafter "the Program"). The Program is licensed under the
GNU General Public License, version 2, whose full text ships alongside this
file as GPLv2.txt.

The exact, pinned version of the Program that Lares bundles is:

    Git for Windows / MinGit v2.55.0.windows.3
    (Git for Windows 2.55.0(3), bundled as MinGit 64-bit)

For any binary distribution of Lares that includes the Program, and for a
period of at least THREE (3) YEARS from the date Lares distributed that binary
(or for as long as Lares offers spare parts or customer support for that
product version, whichever is longer), Edward Turk will provide to any third
party, upon written request and for a charge no more than the cost of
physically performing source distribution, a complete machine-readable copy of
the corresponding source code for the exact pinned version of the Program named
above, to be distributed under the terms of the GNU General Public License,
version 2, as published by the Free Software Foundation.

"Corresponding source code" means the complete source code for all modules the
Program contains, plus any associated interface definition files and the
scripts used to control compilation and installation of the executable, as
required by GPLv2 Section 3.

The exact corresponding source archive for the pinned version above is
RETAINED by Edward Turk and is available on request under this offer. The
canonical upstream location for that source is recorded in SOURCE-URL.txt
(provided for convenience; this written offer, not the URL, is what satisfies
GPLv2 Section 3(b)).

To exercise this offer, send a written request to:

    Edward Turk
    turke6756@gmail.com

Please include the exact Lares version you received and the pinned Program
version named above so the corresponding source can be identified.

This offer is valid to anyone who receives this notice and applies to the
Program only. Lares' own code is licensed separately under the Apache License,
Version 2.0 (see LICENSE); this offer does not extend to it.
